messages:
anika-partnerships: FYI — APAC SI partner asking for a single marketplace private-offer that bundles a 12‑month reserved commit + 3% hardware rebate on appliances. They want an auto-renew protection clause (no cliff discount drops) and an optional conversion credit if usage ramps beyond commit. Can we scope constraints and a safe pricing band?

mike-sales: Sounds reasonable. key asks: 1) single SKU on marketplace that shows both software commit and hardware rebate, 2) auto-renew protection window (30d), 3) a one-time usage->commit conversion credit up to 20% of excess usage in Q1.

sarah-ops: Marketplace limitations: private offers can attach a single SKU but billing flows separate (software metered vs hardware one-time SKU). We'll need marketplace billing to emit two line items; UI can display them as a bundle, but contract still separates. Also need to check auto-renew semantics — some marketplaces don't let us lock pricing without a manual private-offer renewal.

anika-partnerships: OK. So plan A: create composite UI SKU (bundle-sku) that maps to two backend SKUs (commit-sku + hardware-credit-sku). Plan B (fallback): two private offers linked in docs + partner-facing bundle sheet. Which do we want to prototype?

josh-product: Prototype Plan A but keep Plan B as fallback. For Plan A we must define mapping rules and renewal guardrails:

```
# SKU mapping (example)
bundle_sku: REDW-BUNDLE-APPL-12
maps_to:
  - commit_sku: REDW-COMMIT-12 (metered monthly token units)
  - hw_credit_sku: REDW-HW-REBATE (one-time negative line item applied at onboarding)
renewal_guard: 30d lock window where pricing cannot drop >5% from prior term unless partner requests
conversion_credit: up to 20% of Q1 overage, paid as future invoice credit, expires 90d
```

josh-product: Also add a clause: if partner requests early upgrade to a higher commit, conversion_credit prorated and applied immediately; else it sits as invoice credit.

mike-sales: Commercial note — we should cap the hw rebate to $200k per account to control risk and require SI to provide serials + installation proof for hw-credit redemption.

sarah-ops: Ops checklist:
- validate marketplace supports negative one-time line item
- test dual-line mapping in staging (billing simulator)
- add webhook that mints conversion credits as invoices with tag "conversion-credit"

marketplace-bot: private-offer-validator: Staging check failed for REDW-BUNDLE-APPL-12: marketplace API rejects negative price for hw_credit_sku in sandbox. Recommend: use post-provision voucher flow instead.

anika-partnerships: Good catch. So revised approach: bundle SKU UI + backend creates commit_sku + issues a voucher for hw rebate after install verification. Update conversion_credit flow to be redeemable as voucher too.

mike-sales: I'll draft partner-facing T&Cs: voucher redemption steps, serial upload, 90d expiry, $200k cap, renew protection 30d, conversion credit rules. Will ping legal.

sarah-ops: From an implementation timeline: if we accept voucher flow we can prototype in 2 sprints (billing integration + partner UI). If we try negative line items, it'll add unknown marketplace approvals (4+ weeks).

anika-partnerships: Thanks everyone. Action items: @mike-sales draft commercial terms by EOD Wed, @sarah-ops start billing sandbox test for dual-line mapping and voucher path, @josh-product prepare product brief + UI mock for bundle SKU. I’ll sync with SI next Tue to confirm install verification requirements. :thumbsup:
